channel.title: Pier & Point · Arterra
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Arterra (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Added · Arterra: The record had no address
item.description: The record had no address. The Assessor's active lot 8704008 lists the address 300 Berry St. Added as the record's address. Source: https://data.sf.gov/resource/acdm-wktn.json?blklot=8704008.

item.title: Correction · Arterra: Arterra, 300 Berry St.: OpenStreetMap and the building permit call it…
item.description: Arterra, 300 Berry St.: OpenStreetMap and the building permit call it apartments, but the Assessor's 2022 roll classes its unit parcels as condominiums, and the page now says so. Source: DataSF Assessor Historical Secured Property Tax Rolls 2022 (data.sf.gov/resource/wv5m-vpq2.json); DataSF Building Permits 200509273964; OpenStreetMap way 48569995.
item.source: DataSF Assessor Historical Secured Property Tax Rolls 2022 (data.sf.gov/resource/wv5m-vpq2.json); DataSF Building Permits 200509273964; OpenStreetMap way 48569995

item.title: Correction · Arterra: Arterra now uses its Assessor lot lines
item.description: Arterra now uses its Assessor lot lines. Source: DataSF Assessor parcels (acdm-wktn), lot 8704008.

item.title: Correction · Arterra: Arterra's topping-off is now dated July 2007: SocketSite reported it on July…
item.description: Arterra's topping-off is now dated July 2007: SocketSite reported it on July 30, 2007, and a reader comment puts the party about a week earlier. The notes also now say Avalon II's Assessor lot is shared by four lots, not many per-unit lots. Source: DataSF Parcels (acdm-wktn); SocketSite, July 30, 2007 (socketsite.com/archives/2007/07/arterra_300_berry_tops_off_and_aims_for_a_spring_openin.html).

item.title: Added · Arterra: Arterra now shows its construction permit as completed on Apr 6, 2009
item.description: Arterra now shows its construction permit as completed on Apr 6, 2009. Source: DBI building permits via DataSF (https://data.sf.gov/resource/i98e-djp9.json?permit_number=200509273964).

item.title: Correction · Arterra: The map notes said about 275 units
item.description: The map notes said about 275 units; the cited SocketSite post says 268, so a dated note was added. The 2009 built year now cites the DataSF Assessor roll for the per-unit condominium lots at 300 Berry, the 2007 topping-out milestone cites its SocketSite post (16 floors, spring 2008 target), and the comparison with other condo-mapped towers no longer lists Avalon II and III. Source: SocketSite, 2006-04 (https://socketsite.com/archives/2006/04/the_arterra_cle.html); DataSF Assessor Historical Secured Property Tax Rolls, 300 Berry St condominium lots (https://data.sf.gov/resource/wv5m-vpq2.json?parcel_number=8704012); SocketSite, 2007-07-30 (https://socketsite.com/archives/2007/07/arterra_300_berry_tops_off_and_aims_for_a_spring_openin.html); DataSF Parcels (https://data.sfgov.org/Geographic-Locations-and-Boundaries/Parcels-Active-and-Retired/acdm-wktn).
item.source: SocketSite, 2006-04 (https://socketsite.com/archives/2006/04/the_arterra_cle.html); DataSF Assessor Historical Secured Property Tax Rolls, 300 Berry St condominium lots (https://data.sf.gov/resource/wv5m-vpq2.json?parcel_number=8704012); SocketSite, 2007-07-30 (https://socketsite.com/archives/2007/07/arterra_300_berry_tops_off_and_aims_for_a_spring_openin.html); DataSF Parcels (https://data.sfgov.org/Geographic-Locations-and-Boundaries/Parcels-Active-and-Retired/acdm-wktn)

item.title: Complete · Arterra: Construction permit completed: DBI recorded new-construction… (Apr 6, 2009)
item.description: Construction permit completed: DBI recorded new-construction permit 200509273964 (16 stories, 268 dwelling units, 300 Berry St) as completed on this date. A permit's completion date is not an opening date. (Apr 6, 2009). Source: San Francisco Department of Building Inspection, via DataSF.
item.source: San Francisco Department of Building Inspection, via DataSF

item.title: Complete · Arterra: Arterra (300 Berry St) completed: the per-unit condominium lots carry… (~2009)
item.description: Arterra (300 Berry St) completed: the per-unit condominium lots carry year built 2009 in the DataSF Assessor roll (~2009). Source: https://data.sf.gov/resource/wv5m-vpq2.json?parcel_number=8704012.

item.title: Under construction · Arterra: Arterra (300 Berry St) reported topped off at 16 floors… (~Jul 2007)
item.description: Arterra (300 Berry St) reported topped off at 16 floors (SocketSite, July 30, 2007, citing Intracorp; a reader comment dates the topping-off party about a week earlier). Intracorp expected completion and closing of escrows in spring 2008 (~Jul 2007). Source: https://socketsite.com/archives/2007/07/arterra_300_berry_tops_off_and_aims_for_a_spring_openin.html.
